title: device request body github.pull_status
description: A fresh read of pull-request states by a device assigned to the workgroup (ADR-084 section 2, 05-runner.md section 11): the organization and workgroup the requester reads them for, the task when known (the device then resolves the identity of that task), and 1-50 distinct pull requests.

pulls.description: distinct pull requests; the device answers a request that repeats one with step failed with code upstream_error (05-runner.md section 11)
